PROJECT CASE STUDY · IOT & EMBEDDED SYSTEMS

IoT-based home
automation.

A voice-enabled prototype that controls two LED bulbs and a fan through connected services.

ESP8266 · VOICE CONTROL

FOCUS AREAS

NodeMCU8266 Arduino IDE Blynk IoT Google Webhooks / IFTTT 5V SPDT relay

ROLE & TOOLS

Designed and assembled the prototype, then connected the controller to voice-triggered commands.

The challenge

Make common home devices easy to switch through voice commands while connecting a low-cost microcontroller to an IoT service.

What I worked on

Used a NodeMCU8266 programmed with Arduino IDE, Blynk IoT, Google webhooks through IFTTT, and a 5V single-channel SPDT relay to operate two LED bulbs and a fan.

Outcome and learning

Demonstrated a connected control flow from voice command to relay switching and gained practical experience with IoT service integration and microcontroller-based automation.
